items.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing

items.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom

items.title: Discord now formats Markdown previews right
items.summary: Discord's latest update released today has a big improvement for Markdown previews: they should now render correctly instead of with "a bunch of symbols," according to the company.
